title: AudioRequest
description: Input of POST /audio: what to generate.

text.description: Text to generate speech for (at most 100 characters). The frontend enforces the limit now; POST /audio will enforce it in a later version.

emotion.description: Emotion the text is spoken with (free text for now, e.g. "joyful", "eerie", "angry").

voiceId.description: Optional. Id of the Gradium voice to speak with (a catalogue voice or one of the team's custom voices). When absent, the service picks a voice from the emotion and the language of the text.
